title: Comparing the Character Designs of MewType In and Out of Virtual Reality

A design can tell audiences a lot about a character, giving them an idea or an expectation before their personality is expressed. title: How BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Uses Anime and Manga Culture To Shape Its Identity
partialText: The musical adventures of the girls bands in BanG Dream! have always been integrated with anime. But as a new entry BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA is even more marinated in said culture. The characters of YUME∞MITA live adjacent to Akihabara, long seen as a mecca of otaku culture in Japan. So, of course these girls are going to be steeped in anime and manga material, and it shapes both their identities and the vibe of YUME∞MITA.
